newsitem.title: USA: Northwest Airlines matches fare sale.
newsitem.headline: Northwest Airlines matches fare sale.

text.p: Northwest Airlines Corp said Monday it has matched Delta Air Lines Inc's winter fare sale, which includes discounts of up to 40 percent.
A spokesman for the Minnesota-based carrier said Northwest will match prices on all competing routes, including transatlantic flights.
"We have already matched them," said Northwest spokesman Jon Austin.
All sale conditions will be the same as Delta's, the spokesman said.
Earlier, Delta said it is offering discounts of up to 40 percent on flights throughout North America, Europe, Asia and the Caribbean.
UAL Corp's United Airlines and AMR Corp's American Airlines also said they would match the winter fare sale.
